source: NCERT Class XI, Performing Arts & Cultural Heritage of India, Ch. 8 (Fairs, Festivals and Cultural Institutions of India).

sections.heading: 1. Fairs and Festivals — Their Role
points: Fairs (**melas**) and festivals express India's **religious, seasonal and cultural diversity** and strengthen community life.
They may be **religious, harvest/seasonal, or trade-based**.
Many are linked to pilgrimage, art, crafts and commerce.

sections.heading: 2. Major Fairs (Melas)
points: **Kumbh Mela** — the largest religious gathering on Earth (Prayagraj, Haridwar, Nashik, Ujjain); a UNESCO ICH.
**Pushkar Fair (Rajasthan)** — famous camel/cattle fair.
**Sonepur Mela (Bihar)** — Asia's largest cattle fair.
**Surajkund Mela (Haryana)** — crafts fair; **Hemis Festival (Ladakh)**; **Hornbill Festival (Nagaland)**; **Gangasagar Mela (Bengal)**.

sections.heading: 3. Major Festivals (Seasonal/Regional)
points: **Harvest festivals:** Pongal (TN), Makar Sankranti, Lohri (Punjab), Bihu (Assam), Onam (Kerala), Baisakhi (Punjab).
**Pan-Indian:** Diwali, Holi, Dussehra, Raksha Bandhan, Eid, Christmas, Guru Nanak Jayanti.
**Regional:** Durga Puja (Bengal), Ganesh Chaturthi (Maharashtra), Rath Yatra (Puri), Chhath (Bihar).

sections.heading: 4. Cultural Institutions of India
points: **Sangeet Natak Akademi** — for music, dance and drama.
**Lalit Kala Akademi** — for fine/visual arts.
**Sahitya Akademi** — for literature.

**National School of Drama (NSD)**; **Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA)**; **Archaeological Survey of India (ASI)** (protects monuments); **National Museum, National Gallery of Modern Art**; **Zonal Cultural Centres**.
These institutions **preserve, promote and document** India's cultural heritage.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Kumbh Mela = largest religious gathering (UNESCO ICH); Pushkar = camel fair (Rajasthan).
Sonepur Mela (Bihar) = Asia's largest cattle fair; Hornbill = Nagaland.
Harvest festivals: Pongal (TN), Bihu (Assam), Onam (Kerala), Lohri/Baisakhi (Punjab).
Sangeet Natak Akademi = performing arts; Lalit Kala = fine arts; Sahitya Akademi = literature.
ASI protects monuments; IGNCA = arts documentation.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Sangeet Natak Akademi = performing arts**; **Lalit Kala Akademi = visual/fine arts**; **Sahitya Akademi = literature** (do not confuse).
The **Kumbh Mela** rotates among Prayagraj, Haridwar, Nashik and Ujjain.
**Onam = Kerala**; **Pongal = Tamil Nadu**; **Bihu = Assam**.
The **ASI** is responsible for protecting monuments and archaeological sites.
